title: DETECTION OF EPHA3 AS MARKER OF PRESENCE OF SOLID TUMOR
abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide methods and compositions for detecting non-hematopoietic, non-tumor EphA3-expressing cells in cancer patients and for monitoring prognosis of patients by using EphA3 as a detection marker.SOLUTION: Level of EphA3+ non-hematopoietic, non-tumor cells in peripheral blood is used for diagnosing presence of a solid tumor. Methods further comprise a step of determining whether the EphA3+ cells express CD34, CD45, CD44, CD90, and/or KDR. Methods for treating patients having increased level of EphA3-expressing non-hematopoietic, non-tumor cells in the blood are also described.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4
